question: In which of the following states of India is Nongkrem festival celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nongkrem festival** is celebrated in the state of **Meghalaya**.
 
• The festival is a significant cultural event for the **Khasi tribe** of Meghalaya.
 
• It is a five-day harvest festival held annually to thank the deit
